    Synopsis:
        Incheon airport topped global international passenger rankings in H1 2026 with 38.39M passengers, aided by disruption to Middle Eastern hubs (Dubai) caused by the US-Iran conflict, which rerouted transfer traffic through East Asia. Heathrow ranked second. Istanbul overtook Heathrow as Europe's busiest airport by total passengers in July.
